rationale: The pass addresses the diagnosed concentration of weak unit economics and uncommitted distribution by making an accountant or ERP implementer a contractual channel and first-line reviewer for the existing high-volume, multi-entity construction/field-service beachhead. It preserves the read-only, contingent-recovery identity and customer control, uses no claim of an existing partner, and turns signed channel terms plus measured payback into a gate. This could bound founder labor, improve trusted acquisition and compound partner-specific deployment knowledge; it remains unproven until pilots establish leakage, delivery margin, channel economics and monitoring conversion.
